name: codex-token-meter
description: Live per-agent token usage (input / cached / output / reasoning), model and estimated cost for Codex main agents and sub-agents: an in-app panel beside the conversation in Codex Desktop and the ChatGPT desktop app, a floating always-on-top mini window, a Codex CLI statusline, a terminal TUI and a local web dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: Live token usage, model and cost per agent and sub-agent
interface.longDescription: Open the Token Meter panel beside a conversation (Codex Desktop or Work mode / Codex in the ChatGPT desktop app) to see the current session's main agent and sub-agents: input, cached, output and reasoning tokens, model, latest request delta and estimated USD cost, refreshed live from local Codex rollout files.
defaultPrompt: Show how many tokens each sub-agent used in this session
